Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __to the subscriber on a display device associated with a set-top terminal__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription tier or service package__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __in real-time or near real-time__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is dynamically updated__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __and comparing it against the list of subscriber's channel identifiers__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __before displaying to the subscriber__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __that is independent of the content delivery provider__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider __such that only programs accessible to the subscriber under the subscriber's service agreement are retained__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device in communication with the machine__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __from subscriber account information maintained by the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __including service tier and package details__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is maintained locally on the machine__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __from the machine-accessible medium__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information __and cross-referencing against the locally maintained list__; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __prior to rendering on the display device__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __only to authorized subscribers based on their subscription status__.
